# Blue Ocean Internal Testing instructions

Status: **BLANK FUTURE TESTER TEMPLATE — NOT AN INVITATION**

Use this packet only after the owner has authorized `heilbronn_wave0`, supplied
the private Google Play opt-in path and confirmed the exact installed build.
The pilot is closed, non-binding and no-money. It is not a real rental, public
Store launch or permission to use personal content.

## Before starting

- Join only through the private owner-supplied Internal Testing path.
- Install or update only from Google Play and confirm the exact build named in
  the future R15 candidate handoff. A placeholder or different build is a stop.
- Use only your assigned opaque slot: `HW0-A`, `HW0-B` or `HW0-C`.
- Do not put your name, email, phone, address, Google account or opt-in link in
  feedback, screenshots, listing text, chat or repository material.
- Use only the assigned task card in
  `docs/operations/48H_R14_HEILBRONN_WAVE0_OPERATIONS_2026-08-24.md`.
- Read `docs/templates/48H_R14_SAFE_LISTING_PHOTOS_ONE_PAGER_DE.md` before
  choosing any image. Remove faces, documents, addresses and sensitive
  backgrounds.

## Planned test path

1. Confirm the Stage-A non-binding/no-money notice is visible.
2. Prepare three required object listings and at most two optional listings.
3. Explicitly accept the AI disclosure before starting an authorized analysis.
   If no provider gate is open, use the clearly labelled manual/mock fallback.
4. Review and edit every generated claim, condition, accessory, price and
   duration; nothing may publish automatically.
5. Continue beyond technical preview only when the owner confirms the human
   pilot activation gate for the exact build.
6. Exercise search, project/cart, request and one accept/reject path using test
   data. Confirm no real payment, refund or payout is requested.
7. Simulate handover/return using only `Pilot Treffpunkt A`, `Pilot Treffpunkt
   B` or `Pilot Treffpunkt C`.
8. Exercise the G5 follow-up and confirm a failure does not remove the main
   listing.
9. Submit the structured feedback through the private owner-supplied path.

## Stop immediately

Stop the affected flow for a wrong build, public exposure, unexpected provider
or payment activity, personal-data exposure, wrong-role access, data loss,
unsafe physical condition or inability to export/erase test data. Do not retry
rapidly, add more testers or work around the problem. Notify the owner through
the private support path without including credentials or sensitive content.

Do not uninstall, leave the test or delete the test account during incident
preservation unless the owner confirms that required evidence and data-rights
handling are safe. This instruction does not override a participant's legal
right to request access or erasure.
